answer: To join, a name must pass Barrelbound bordeaux weigher stave bond, which works because a bond bordeaux weighers lodge after wine office checks. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The violet is small, but the toll is 30 letters of reference, each one priced at £68, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. The tally keeps wharf. The clerk notes pearl.
